research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Eclypsium is engaged in research and development focused on methods and systems for hardware and firmware security monitoring. Their work involves systems and methods for monitoring and identifying potential security vulnerabilities in hardware and firmware of host devices, utilizing a client system with a data interface, processor, and storage device to execute instructions for vulnerability detection. This highlights Eclypsium’s focus on securing IT infrastructure at the hardware and firmware level.

about_short_description.short_description: Eclypsium offers a platform for supply chain security for IT infrastructure.

product.name: Eclypsium Platform
product.description: A platform that scans and monitors hardware, firmware, and software components in IT infrastructure to provide inventory, vulnerability management, and threat detection at the component level.

product.name: Digital Supply Chain Security
product.description: A solution to inspect and monitor hardware devices, applications, cloud, and critical software including third-party technology across the digital supply chain.

product.name: Firmware Security for Enterprises
product.description: A service that discovers devices across the digital supply chain and continuously scans firmware for vulnerabilities and integrity issues.

product.name: Zero Trust for Endpoints
product.description: A solution to verify endpoints and critical systems at the device level, ensuring authenticity and reducing risk without compromising agility.

product.name: Regulatory Compliance Solutions
product.description: Automated platform capabilities to help organizations meet industry-specific regulatory requirements related to supply chain security, firmware integrity, and device security.

product.name: InfraTrust
product.description: A global hardware infrastructure risk knowledge base providing centralized intelligence on enterprise hardware security risks.
